crossRefs.note: A righteous person is cautious in friendship, but the way of the wicked leads them astray.
There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.
“Because you have said, ‘We have made a covenant with death, and we are in agreement with Sheol. When the overflowing…
The Pharisees therefore answered them, “You aren’t also led astray, are you?
Those of the Pharisees who were with him heard these things, and said to him, “Are we also blind?”
“I myself most certainly thought that I ought to do many things contrary to the name of Jesus of Nazareth.
Examine your own selves, whether you are in the faith. Test your own selves. Or don’t you know about your own selves…

translations.web: There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.
translations.bsb: There is a way that seems right to a man, but its end is the way of death.
translations.kjv: There is a way that seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.
translations.asv: There is a way which seemeth right unto a man, But the end thereof are the ways of death.
